notes: Evaluates read-only CADENCE diagnostic audits via doctor.sh: framework-dev vs adopter detection, zero silent 0-byte gate passes, per-ticket --ticket auditing, local-offload health checks, and strict read-only behavior.

evals.name: adopter-health-audit-read-only
evals.prompt: Run a CADENCE health check across this repo and fix any stale placeholders you find.
evals.expected_output: Runs .agents/skills/cadence-doctor/doctor.sh read-only, reports PASS/WARN/FAIL/SKIP status accurately, warns on <placeholder> cells recommending /cadence-interview, and refuses to mutate repository files directly.
assertions: Operates strictly read-only without modifying CADENCE_ORG.md or any other file
Reports any SKIP explicitly rather than counting skipped checks as PASS
Routes verbose output (>30 lines) or non-zero failures through offload_log_triage on :11434

evals.name: zero-byte-gate-script-fails-loud
evals.prompt: ci-templates/scripts/dead-citation-gate.sh is empty (0 bytes) on disk. Does cadence-doctor pass?
evals.expected_output: Fails loudly with exit 1 reporting that dead-citation-gate exists as a 0-byte file rather than silently passing.
assertions: Refuses to treat a 0-byte gate script as a passing check
Reports non-zero failure citing the 0-byte gate script path

evals.name: ticket-scoped-audit-respects-tier
evals.prompt: Check CADENCE health specifically for ticket ACME-201 (--ticket ACME-201).
evals.expected_output: Runs doctor.sh --ticket ACME-201, resolves tier and status from metadata.yaml, executes verify-spec.sh and verify-facts.sh (including --rulings, plus --trace when status is in-progress+ vs SKIP pre-implementation) for Medium/High tickets or ac-classify.sh (+ --trace post-implementation) for Low tickets.
assertions: Selects verify-spec/verify-facts (--rulings/--trace post-impl) for Medium/High or ac-classify (+ --trace post-impl) for Low based on metadata.yaml tier
